title: Synthetic literals under generic credential names
summary: Synthetic random literals assigned to api_key, password, dotted and quoted password, client_secret and similar generic names, with dots, quotes, Unicode and CRLF around them and no provider format.
rationale: Every reference exclusion in the neighbouring Cases is only trustworthy if a real literal in the same position is still reported. These are the counterweight, and because the values have no provider format the assignment name is the only signal.

expectation.rationale: Flagged under project policy: with no format to recognise, a real-looking literal under a credential name is treated as a secret. The policy is the project's; it is not provider evidence.

incidents.summary: Promote the reference-syntax literal-credential positive controls out of regressions.test.mjs
